rca of the issue: MarketingAnalyticsPage.jsx Slice L.i widget conversion block (lines 168-219) used the identifier `data` which is not declared anywhere in the component. The component's fetched state is `overview` (line 28). Every render past `loading` false hit this JSX and threw `ReferenceError: data is not defined`, crashing the entire /admin/marketing/analytics route into React's dev error overlay. Reproduction: log in as admin@aquaterra.com, visit /admin/marketing/analytics — see red 'Uncaught runtime errors' overlay. Mitigation applied: renamed all six `data.*` references to `overview.*` in the widget tile block (chat conversation_started/leads_captured/escalations/conversion_pct and form views/submissions/submission_rate_pct). Post-fix the widget tile renders with all 7 mini-stats populated (chat: 232/68/82/29.3%, form: 0/0/—).
